name: GDKHOST.NET small data center
notes: GDKHOST says it provides hosting services from its own small data center in Georgia, built from the ground up with redundant cooling and power systems. Network and business-directory evidence ties AS203136 LLC Ordunet/GDKHOST infrastructure and branches to Zugdidi in Samegrelo-Zemo Svaneti. Capacity was not disclosed.

name: Cloud9 Dinamo Arena carrier-neutral data center
notes: Cloud9 says most services are delivered from its own Tbilisi-based carrier-neutral data center at Dinamo Stadium/2 Akaki Tsereteli Ave., designed and built to Tier III requirements with 3 independent power substations, backup generator, N+N power feeds, and 250 Gbps interconnection capacity. Data Center Map lists the Cloud9 Dinamo Arena site in Tbilisi and reports 0.5 MW.

name: NewTelco Tbilisi
notes: NewTelco's company site lists NewTelco Georgia Ltd. at A. Politkovskaia Street, Tbilisi and references NewTelco Georgia as a neutral data center used since February 2016. DC Hub reports NewTelco Tbilisi as operational in Tbilisi with 3.0 MW power capacity; Inflect likewise identifies a NewTelco data center on Ana Politkovskaia Street.

name: Caucasus Online Datacenter - Tbilisi
notes: Caucasus Online's service page markets a modern data center and colocation service. DC Hub lists Caucasus Online Datacenter - Tbilisi as operational in Tbilisi with 3.0 MW reported power capacity, and Connectbase lists the Tbilisi data center in its provider directory.

name: WORLDBUS Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists WORLDBUS Data Center at 5 Oqromchedelebi St, Tbilisi, Georgia, offering cabinets, servers and remote hands, and labels the site Tier 3. DC Hub's Tbilisi nearby-facility listing reports WORLDBUS at 3.0 MW. No primary facility specification page was found.

name: Proservice Data Center
notes: Art House Architects lists Proservice Data Center as a completed Tbilisi project from 2013. Data Center Map and local business-directory results identify Proservice Data Center at P. Kavtaradze dead end 3 in Tbilisi. Capacity was not disclosed.

name: G Data Data-Center #1
notes: Uptime Institute's awards page lists G Data LLC's G Data Data-Center #1 in Tbilisi, Georgia. Search-result context from Uptime indicates a Tier III Certification of Design Documents award, so this is treated as a planned/design-certified facility rather than confirmed operational; capacity was not disclosed.

name: Bitfury Tbilisi cryptocurrency data center
notes: Baxtel lists Bitfury Tbilisi as a fully operational facility in Tbilisi and identifies Bitfury Group as a bitcoin miner with two facilities and 73 MW across its markets, but facility-level MW is paywalled/undisclosed. Secondary technical discussion references Bitfury's Tbilisi data center and its immersion-cooling efficiency.
